doc_class_description: A Sri Lanka Cabinet Decision is an official policy or action agreed by the Cabinet of Ministers, shaping governance, law, and national development in the country.

latest_doc_d.description: Obtaining financial assistance of the Government of India for the implementation effort of rehabilitation and reconstruction programmes in Sri Lanka in the aftermath of the Cyclone 'Ditwah'
latest_doc_d.decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-06-30 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
latest_doc_d.decision_details_body: - The reconstruction needs of about US$ 3.5 billion have been identified for the physical damage of US$ 2.1 billion and economic damage of US$ 1.4 billion as a result of the impact caused to Sri Lanka in November 2025 by Cyclone 'Ditwah'. During the disaster period, the Government of India provided the necessary assistance for disaster relief and emergency response activities under 'Operation Sagar Bandhu'. At the discussion held during the visit of the Hon. Minister of Foreign Affairs of India to Sri Lanka on 2025-12-22, it was agreed to provide a disaster relief package to Sri Lanka under 'Operation Sagar Bandhu'. Under this, the Government of India has proposed a relief package of US$ 450 million in the form of a line of credit of US$ 350 million and a grant of US$ 100 million. It has further been agreed that the credit facility of US$ 350 million will be provided in the form of a long‑term line of credit of US$ 250 million and a short-term line of credit of US$ 100 million, and a grant of US$ 100 million will be provided so as to cover the areas of infrastructure, connectivity, health, education, housing, water supply and disaster management. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to enter into relevant agreements between the two parties to obtain the proposed credit facility, was approved by the Cabinet.
